name: pi-agent-remote-effects
description: Effects that leave this machine are the human's to authorise. cc-safety-net already stops what destroys local work; this stops what publishes. Both are irreversible, but only one is irreversible for other people too.
author: pi-agent

rules.name: remote-git-push
rules.reason: Pushing publishes commits to a remote others pull from. Read the diff, then run it yourself.

rules.name: remote-npm-publish
rules.reason: Publishing to a registry cannot be undone; the version number is spent even after an unpublish.

rules.name: remote-docker-push
rules.reason: Pushing an image publishes it to a registry others pull from.

rules.name: remote-gh-release
rules.reason: Creating a release publishes artifacts and notifies watchers.
